intro.text: A plan by Odium's forces to seize the tower city of Urithiru from the humans, put forward by the Fused Raboniel and approved by the Nine.
An attack on Urithiru by Odium's armies under Raboniel, who corrupted the tower's defences, leaving nearly all its Radiants unconscious, and made Navani Kholin surrender the tower.
The capture and occupation of Urithiru by Odium's forces under Raboniel. It ended when Navani Kholin bonded the Sibling and the tower's restored defences knocked out the Fused and Regals inside.

items.text: Raboniel brought her plan to the Nine. She argued that the human Radiants were overtaking the Fused in research and technology, but had not yet mastered their powers or the tower, so Urithiru should be attacked at once. The Nine agreed and asked Taravangian to lure Dalinar and Jasnah out of Urithiru.

Heavenly Ones dropped Raboniel and some five hundred Fused and Regals far from the tower, and they marched for weeks, moving only at night or in storms to avoid Windrunner patrols. They made their final approach in an Everstorm.

Thirty Deepest Ones went ahead through the rock and silently murdered the guards at a lower entrance and the scholars studying the crystal pillar. When a patrol came to check, Raboniel's force killed it quickly and joined the Deepest Ones at the pillar.

Raboniel filled the crystal pillar with Voidlight, slowed by the Sibling's resistance, as human soldiers began fighting her force. Once she succeeded, the tower's defences were turned around: they no longer stopped the Fused using their powers, and every Radiant in the tower except Kaladin fell unconscious.

A large singer army then poured in. Moash used Jezrien's Honorblade to bring troops through the Oathgate from Kholinar, and dozens of Heavenly Ones flew in through balconies. Tshadr, the tower's only Shardbearer who was not a Radiant, was quickly taken down.

Kaladin found he had lost Gravitation but kept Adhesion. Spanreeds stopped working. Navani gathered her scribes and runners in the map room and called up the tower's seven garrisons and the remaining Windrunners. Battalionlord Teofil told her they could not hold without reviving the Radiants, so she ordered every soldier to storm the pillar room.
Raboniel met the Pursuer, who wanted every unconscious Radiant killed. She told him to kill only those who resisted, but gave him leave to kill Kaladin should he come across him.

Teofil's troops faked a retreat to lure stormform Regals into a room where lightning rods drew off their attacks, shot them down with crossbows and charged on, but the Pursuer arrived and they were slaughtered short of the pillar room. Meanwhile, guided by the Sibling, Navani's artifabrians filled a crystal node with Stormlight and broke it, raising a shield around the pillar.

Navani was captured and brought to Raboniel. Raboniel demanded the unconscious Radiants and every weapon in the tower, and declared that humans must live under singer law and obey any singer's order. In return they could keep their work and trade. Navani accepted and formally surrendered Urithiru.

The tower had four nodes, each a direct line to its heart; destroying one had weakened the shield. Raboniel set out to find the other three, since any of them would let her finish corrupting the tower, and Navani, speaking through the Sibling's crystal veins, asked Kaladin to find and guard them, or break them if he had to.

When Deepest Ones found another node, the Sibling sent Kaladin there. Armed only with a spear and half his powers, he fought the Pursuer, trapped him in a stone room with the Sibling's help and smashed the node. Raboniel stabbed him in the chest but let him go.

Navani built Kaladin a fabrial glove with which he could fly, if roughly. When the Sibling told her of a node hidden in the Breakaway market's well, Raboniel was secretly listening and sent troops there.

Kaladin raced to the well, faced the Pursuer and then Leshwi, and dived in to destroy the node, only for the Pursuer to seal him under the water. He escaped through tunnels with the glove, then leapt from the tower into a highstorm. Dalinar, riding the storm in a vision, saw him and blew the unconscious Kaladin back into the tower.

Word of Kaladin's fight spread, small clashes broke out between singers and humans, and many people drew shash glyphs on their foreheads in support of him. Venli, Rlain and Dabbid freed Lift from a cage, and she healed Kaladin and the unconscious Teft.

Kaladin, Teft, Dabbid and Lift planned to wake the Radiants in the infirmary with Lift's powers. Kaladin drew the Pursuer into a fight in the atrium while Lift and Teft went to the infirmary, but Moash ambushed them there. He cut Lift down, killed Teft's spren Phendorana with a raysium dagger, killed Teft and destroyed the last node.

Kaladin beat the Pursuer and drove him off, but was overcome with grief at Teft's death. When a Fused threw Kaladin's father Lirin from the tower, Kaladin dived after him, swore the Fourth Ideal and saved him, then went back to fight.

Navani reached the unguarded crystal pillar and overpowered Raboniel. As Moash came to kill her, she hummed the tone of anti-Voidlight to clear some of the Sibling's corruption, and together they sang the Rhythm of the Tower. The Sibling bonded her, and they restored the tower's defences, knocking out every Fused and Regal and waking the Radiants.

Kaladin joined a large battle between humans and singers at the Breakaway market and called on the singers to surrender. Navani then found Raboniel still alive and, at her request, killed her for good with a raysium dagger.
Once the tower's Fused and Regals were dead or unconscious, the occupation was over and the Radiants held Urithiru again, now with all its protections in place.
During the occupation Navani, working with Raboniel, learned how to make anti-Voidlight and anti-Stormlight and found that Lights respond to music and vibration.
Navani and Rlain each bonded a spren, and Kaladin swore the Fourth Ideal.
